body:

see https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/29444#issuecomment-2627762425

Experimental annotations that need to be reviewed are here: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1oBguxW0oaRloaiDajxfELfQ6SeiDpo5ly4v1sXXw7dg/edit?gid=0#gid=0

Impacted groups: 
AgBase 1
AspGD 2
BHF-UCL 3 - done
CACAO 1

MGI 2 
~MTBBASE 1~
Reactome 4

~SGD 3~ done
~TAIR 1~

Hamap 1
UniRule 1
Reactome 3
Interpro 2



Thanks.
